findings.title: Nonfaithfulness of the strict augmentation bimodule functor

source_location.statement: Definition and Lemma 2.9 and its proof

findings.claim: The derived tensor functor of the expressly specified augmentation Sigma-E bimodule Z is fully faithful.

all_hypotheses.E: Z direct sum I, I=Z(-1)[-1], square-zero generator epsilon
all_hypotheses.bimodule: Strict two augmentation actions in Ch^Z
all_hypotheses.input_category: Unbounded complexes of internally Z-graded abelian groups; two finite free cofibrant E-modules

findings.counterexample: Degree-(0,0) E-linear map f:E tensor I -> E with f(a)=epsilon and f(epsilon*a)=0. It represents the generator of the rank-one degree-zero derived Hom group, since inputs are free and all differentials zero. Tensoring with the specified right augmentation E-module Z kills epsilon; hence F(f)=0.
findings.alternative_reading: A genuine derived Koszul bimodule could implement the desired equivalence, but the manuscript explicitly gives strict augmentation actions and derives that Quillen functor. Underived versus derived does not rescue the assertion on free cofibrant inputs.
findings.repair: Specify a different derived bimodule with the endomorphism action. The two-term K=[Sigma(1)u -> Sigma], d(u)=t, u epsilon=1, 1 epsilon=0 demonstrates the missing action; K -> Z is not a bimodule quasi-isomorphism to the strict augmentation bimodule.
findings.repair_verified_scope: Explicit differential, bidegrees, square-zero right action and obstruction to augmentation bimodule linearity checked. Full symmetric monoidal coherence and all geometric/monodromy compatibilities not established.
findings.impact: Corollary 2.20, Definition 2.24, Theorem 3.2 construction, Proposition 3.9 module identifications, multivariable Section 3.10 and later Sigma-linearity require revisiting.
findings.limits: No disproof of the existence of correct Koszul duality, the underlying geometric theorems or the intended central-functor conclusion. Not independent acceptance.

focused_checks.reason: Primary read the exact source pp.6-8 and downstream pp.11-12,16-17,22,32, the complete current report, findings, and retained reviewer-authored dg script/output. The internal grading convention is Z(1) in degree -1, hence epsilon in I=Z(-1)[-1] has bidegree (cohomological 1, internal 1). A=E tensor I and B=E are finite free cofibrant left E-modules in the stated right-induced model structure. The degree-(0,0) E-linear map a->epsilon, epsilon*a->0 is the nonzero generator of H^0 Hom_E(A,B), with zero differential and no homotopy boundaries. Because p.7 expressly chooses both strict augmentation actions in Ch^Z and derives that left Quillen functor, its value on these cofibrant inputs sends this actual map to zero. A target replacement cannot turn the zero derived morphism into a nonzero one. The same witness survives rational scalar extension. The proof's abstract derived endomorphism calculation does not identify the particular adjunction unit. The alternative genuine Koszul action is material counterevidence to a claim of nonexistence of duality, but not to this stated functor: K^{-1}=Sigma*u, d(u)=t, u*epsilon=1 has compatible bidegrees and dg action, while K->Z fails right E-linearity on u. It is therefore a different bimodule, not a resolution of the strict one. Corollary 2.20, Definition 2.24, Theorem 3.2, Proposition 3.9, the multivariable repetition and Lemma 4.20 establish operative dependency. Major is appropriate for this construction failure; no disproof of the geometric conclusions or full monoidal/coherence repair is established. Historical arithmetic execution and visual observations remain attributed to their original reviewer; no unchanged build or scientific computation was rerun.

independent_acceptance.scope: Independent verification of every existing reported Problem only; no claim of a new exhaustive whole-paper review.
